appVersion: KCP v1.0.5 · Made for Karachi Citizens
logOutConfirm: Are you sure you want to log out?
dailyRewardsDesc: Apne Daily Rewards claim karein, 7-din ka streak banayein aur +200 City Credits tak kamayein!
earnCreditsDesc: Jab bhi aapki jama karda report in tasdeeqi milestones par pohnchay gi, aapko mazeed Credits (ek waqt mein +150 tak) milenge:
verifyOthersDesc: Dosron ki shikayat ki tasdeeq karke kamaayein
streakInfoDesc:
Rozana muft points claim karein! Har din inaam barhta hai:

🔹 Din 1: 25 pts
🔹 Din 2: 50 pts
🔹 Din 3: 75 pts
🔹 Din 4: 100 pts
🔹 Din 5: 125 pts
🔹 Din 6: 150 pts
🔹 Din 7: 200 pts 🎉

Din 7 ke baad streak dubara shuru. Ek din miss kiya toh bhi reset!
streakResetNote: Ek din miss karne par streak reset
requiresInternet: Feed mein dekhne ke liye internet chahiye.
noIssueSelected: Details dekhne ke liye map par kisi issue ko tap karein.
searchPlaceholder: Area ya keyword se search karein...
complaintSubmitted: Aapki shikayat jama ho gayi hai.
cameraPermMsg: App needs access to your camera to take complaint photos.
cameraPermRequired: Camera permission is required to capture photos.
welcomeSubtitle:
Your city. Your voice.
Make Karachi better, together.
loginSubtitle: Apne sheher ki issues report karna jaari rakhein.
signUpSubtitle: Hazaron logon ke saath Karachi ko behtar banayein.
improveKcp: KCP behtar banane mein madad karein ya ideas dein
permRemove: Apna data hamesha ke liye hatayein
dropPinTutorialDesc: Custom location par pin lagane ke liye map par kahin bhi tap karein. Pin lagne ke baad, report aage badhane ke liye 'Confirm & Submit' dabayein.
reportInProgressDesc: Aap abhi issue report kar rahe hain. Pehle mukammal karein ya map par wapas jayein.
noSearchResults: Koi location nahi mila. Doosra lafz try karein.
searchErrorMsg: Abhi search nahi ho saki. Connection check karein.
mapOffline: Bagher internet map tiles load nahi hongi.
seasonPrize: Top 10 players ko khaas Daraz vouchers milengay.
internetRequired: KCP istemal karne ke liye WiFi ya Mobile Data se connect karein.
surveyDesc: Aap KCP ka active hissa rahe hain. Hum aapki raaye sunna chahte hain.
locationOffDesc: Map istemal karne, issues report karne aur apne sheher ko explore karne ke liye apne device ki location on karein. App ko sahi kaam karne ke liye aapki location chahiye.
locationNeededDesc: Karachi Complaint Portal ke behtar tajurbe ke liye apne device ki location on karein. Is ke baghair aap sahi tareeqe se issues report nahi kar sakte.
reportHereDesc:
Meri maujuda GPS location istemal karein.
Mouqay par kharay ho kar report karne ke liye behtareen.
pinReportDesc:
Nakshay par jagah chunein.
Pehle dekhe gaye masail ki report karne ke liye misali.
reportingIntroGPSDesc: Apni maujuda location par fori report karein. Taiz aur durust.
reportingIntroPinDesc: Map par kahin bhi pin lagayein. Un masail ke liye behtareen jo aap ne pehle dekhe hon.
gpsUnavailable: Aapka maujuda maqam haasil nahi ho saka. GPS on hai yaqeeni banayein aur dubara try karein, ya Pin Drop method istemal karein.
noWifi_reportHere_desc: Maujuda jagah par masla report karne ke liye internet zaruri hai. WiFi ya Mobile Data se connect karein aur dubara try karein.
noWifi_pinReport_desc: Pin lagane aur report bhejne ke liye internet connection zaruri hai. WiFi ya Mobile Data se connect karein aur dubara try karein.
locOff_reportHere_desc: 'Yahan Report' aapki live GPS position istemal karta hai. Masle ki durust jagah batane ke liye device Settings mein Location on karein.
locOff_pinReport_desc: Aapke device ki location band hai. Aap phir bhi map par pin laga sakte hain, lekin location on karne se zyada durust nataij milte hain aur report asaan se verify hoti hai.
locOff_pinReport_hint: Ishaara: Map par kahin bhi pin lagayein ta ke jagah mutayyan ho
reportHere_tutorial_step1_desc: 'Yahan Report' dabayein ta ke aapki maujuda GPS location foran report ka maqam ban jaye.
reportHere_tutorial_step2_desc: Masle ki nau'iyat ke mutabiq category chunein (Sewerage, Sadkein, Kachra waghera).
reportHere_tutorial_step3_desc: Photo lein ya upload karein aur report confirm karein. Yeh foran map par nazar aayegi!
reportHere_tutorial_tip: 💡 Tab behtareen jab aap masle ki jagah par ya qareeb kharay hon.
pinReport_tutorial_step1_desc: Map par 'Pin Lagayein' button dabayein, phir sahi jagah par pin lagane ke liye map par kahin bhi tap karein.
pinReport_tutorial_step2_desc: Pin lagne ke baad reporting shuru karne ke liye 'Tasdeeq aur Jama' dabayein.
pinReport_tutorial_step3_desc: Category chunein aur photo le kar report mukammal karein. Aapka pin map par rahega!
pinReport_tutorial_tip: 💡 Tip: Un masail ke liye mufeed jo aap ne pehle dekhe hon ya jo aapki maujuda jagah se mukhtalif ilaqe mein hon.
verifyPopupOnSiteDesc: Aap bilkul us jagah par hain. +2 Verifications shaamil ki gayin!
verifyPopupLocalDesc: Aap qareeb hi hain. +1 Verification shaamil ki gayi.
verifyPopupTooFarDesc: Tasdeeq ke liye 3km ke dairey mein hona zaroori hai. Is se data drust rehta hai!
verifyPopupFallbackDesc: Location dastiyab nahi. Standard verification shaamil ki gayi.
timeDelayedVerifyDesc: Aap haal hi mein is jagah ke qareeb the. +1 Tasdeeq shaamil ki gayi!
feedTutorialDesc1: • Apne qareeb ke masail talash karne ke liye Proximity Filter istemal karein!
feedTutorialDesc3: • Local (< 3km) aur Passed By (Pichle 24h) par +1 Tasdeeq milti hai.
feedTutorialDesc4: • Bohat door (> 3km) tasdeeq nahi ho sakti. Aap apni reports tasdeeq nahi kar sakte.
feedTutorialDesc5: • Aik zimmedar shehri banein! Location system mein dhoka dahi par sakht jurmana ya app ban ho sakti hai.
rateLimitDesc: Aap rozana sirf 10 report jama karwa sakte hain. Baraye meherbani kal dobara koshish karein.
distanceErrorDesc: Aap sirf apne maujooda maqam se 200 meter ke andar masail ki report kar sakte hain.
selfDuplicateErrorTitle: Pehle Hi Report Ho Chuka Hai
selfDuplicateErrorDesc: Aap ne pehle hi is maqam par bilkul isi maslay ki report kar di hai. Baraye meherbani mutaaliqa mehakmay ki janib se is maslay ke hal hone ka intezar karein.
duplicateErrorTitle: Masla Pehle Hi Report Ho Chuka Hai
duplicateErrorDesc: Kisi ne pehle hi yahan qareeb mein yeh masla report kar diya hai! Kya aap iski tasdeeq karna chahenge?
